name: emman-reading-room
description: Emman Reading Room - a public-domain research library with an Archival Research Curator agent.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
